title:
Off
the Grid
subtitle:
Visual playground of
fun side projects

items.alt: An insect human hybrid created with Z-Brush and Cinema4D, rendered with Octane.
A 3D rendered video of fluid spheres floating up into a pink sky.
A 3D rendered avatar chilling in colorful sweatpants on an armchair with a remote control and bunny slippers just about to bite into a slice of pizza.
An illustration of an asian woman covering her mouth with her arm. The handwritten font behind her reads 'Je suis ne pas un virus'
A 3D rendered hand floating over the ground forming an 'o' with thumb and pointing finger. The hand is made of glossy, colorful reflective material.

A 3D rendered hand floating over the ground showing three fingers as it was counting. The hand is made of glossy, colorful reflective material. In a looping animation pink smoke is covering the hand from time to time.
Three colorful soap bubbles intersecting wiith each other, particles are floating inside. Behind there is a font reading 'klaaar'.
A 3D rendered hand floating over the ground showing two fingers as it was counting. The hand is made of glossy, dark material. In a looping animation a yellow fluid is circling around it.
A 3D rendered hand floating over the ground showing one finger as it was counting. The hand is made of glossy material.
An animation of illustrated mouths opening and coming towards the camera. In each mouth there is a rotating spiral revealing another mouth. An endless loop.
A small, blue 3D character trying to catch a floating ballon. When failing it is getting angry and showing the finger into the camera.
An illustrated logo with the letters 'dmdrn' and a hexagon shape in the background.
A woman being showered with colorful custard. She is trying to lick it off her face.
A blond woman pressing her nose and tongue onto a scanner. The rest of her face is covered by her long hair.
